statBlock.name: Air Elemental
statBlock.description: A moving funnel of air with a face that briefly forms among the dust and debris.

sections.Damage resistances: Lightning, thunder. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Condition immunities: Exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, unconscious.
sections.Traits:
Air Form. It can move into a hostile creature’s space and stop there. It can pass through an opening as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing.
Elemental Nature. It needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Slam attacks.
Slam. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage.
Whirlwind (Recharge 4–6). Each creature in the elemental’s space makes a DC 13 Strength save. On a failure, it takes 15 (3d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage, is thrown 20 ft. away in a random direction, and falls prone. If the thrown creature hits an object, including a wall or floor, it takes an additional 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage per 10 ft. it was thrown. If thrown at another creature, the second creature makes a DC 13 Dexterity save. On a failure it takes the same collision damage and falls prone. A creature that succeeds on the initial Strength save takes half the initial damage and keeps its position and posture.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), pp. 123–124. Damage resistance wording follows the official errata.

statBlock.name: Earth Elemental
statBlock.description: A walking mass of soil and jagged stone that can sense footsteps through the ground.

sections.Damage resistances: Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Senses: Darkvision 60 ft., tremorsense 60 ft., passive Perception 10.
sections.Traits:
Earth Glide. It can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone without disturbing it.
Siege Monster. It deals double damage to objects and structures.
Elemental Nature. It needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Slam attacks.
Slam. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), pp. 123–124. Damage resistance wording follows the official errata.

statBlock.name: Fire Elemental
statBlock.description: A flickering humanoid outline at the center of a wandering blaze.

sections.Damage resistances: Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Condition immunities: Exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, unconscious.
sections.Traits:
Fire Form. It can move into a hostile creature’s space and stop there. It can pass through an opening as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing. A creature that touches it, or hits it with a melee attack from within 5 ft., takes 5 (1d10) fire damage. The first time the elemental enters a creature’s space on a turn, that creature takes 5 (1d10) fire damage and ignites. The burning creature takes 5 (1d10) fire damage at the start of each of its turns until someone uses an action to put out the flames.
Illumination. It sheds bright light for 30 ft. and dim light for another 30 ft.
Water Susceptibility. It takes 1 cold damage per 5 ft. it moves in water and per gallon of water splashed on it.
Elemental Nature. It needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Touch attacks.
Touch. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 10 (2d6 + 3) fire damage. A creature or flammable object hit by this attack ignites and takes 5 (1d10) fire damage at the start of each of its turns until a creature uses an action to extinguish it.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), pp. 123 and 125. Damage resistance wording follows the official errata.

statBlock.name: Water Elemental
statBlock.description: A cresting wave that rolls across the ground and briefly takes on a recognizable shape.

sections.Damage resistances: Acid. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Condition immunities: Exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, unconscious.
sections.Traits:
Water Form. It can move into a hostile creature’s space and stop there. It can pass through an opening as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing.
Freeze. Cold damage partially freezes the elemental and reduces its speed by 20 ft. until the end of its next turn.
Elemental Nature. It needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Slam attacks.
Slam. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage.
Whelm (Recharge 4–6). Each creature in the elemental’s space makes a DC 15 Strength save. On a failure, it takes 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage. If Large or smaller, it is also grappled (escape DC 14). While held, it is restrained and can breathe only if it can breathe water. On a success, the creature is pushed out of the elemental’s space. The elemental can hold one Large creature or up to two Medium or smaller creatures at once. At the start of each of the elemental’s turns, every target it holds takes another 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage. A creature within 5 ft. can use an action and succeed on a DC 14 Strength check to pull a creature or object out.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), pp. 123 and 125. Errata specifies a Strength check to pull a target out of Whelm and updates damage resistance wording.

statBlock.name: Invisible Stalker
statBlock.description: An air elemental bound into service as a tracker. Magic that reveals invisible creatures shows its faint outline.

sections.Damage resistances: Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Condition immunities: Exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, unconscious.
sections.Languages: Auran. It understands Common but cannot speak it.
sections.Traits:
Invisibility. It is naturally invisible, including while it attacks.
Faultless Tracker. The summoner assigns a quarry. The stalker knows the quarry’s direction and distance while they share a plane. It also knows its summoner’s location.
Elemental Nature. It needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Directed hunter: The stalker waits with its summoner until given a task. It can be tasked to find and kill a specific creature or retrieve an object. Any other assignment breaks the binding and releases the stalker. When it finishes, it returns for more orders while the binding lasts. If its summoner dies before the task is done, it vanishes once it completes the task. Defeat or expiration of the binding also dismisses it. It resents its orders and may exploit vague wording on long assignments.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Slam attacks.
Slam. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), p. 192. Damage resistance wording follows the official errata.

statBlock.name: Azer
statBlock.description: A bronze-skinned craftsperson with a fiery beard, sculpted by another azer and animated from the maker’s own flame.

sections.Traits:
Heated Body. A creature that touches the azer, or hits it with a melee attack from within 5 ft., takes 5 (1d10) fire damage.
Heated Weapons. The azer adds 3 (1d6) fire damage to a hit with a metal melee weapon. The Warhammer action already includes this damage.
Illumination. It sheds bright light for 10 ft. and dim light for another 10 ft.
Living Fire. It needs no food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Actions: Warhammer. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage with one hand or 8 (1d10 + 3) with two hands. Add 3 (1d6) fire damage to either.
